story.title: The Volcano Woke Up and Something Stood Up

narrator.persona: a USGS seismic technician who monitored the eruption

sentences.text: A deep rhythmic thrumming echoed through the seismic sensors, beating like a hollow drum against the bedrock.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The local sheriff called my radio to demand what was breaking our instruments.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Get off the mountain right now.
sentences.speaker: person

sentences.text: I watched the molten crater churn violently as glowing magma parted to reveal an impossibly broad shoulder of solid stone.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Four amber eyes blinked open within the fire, fixing directly on my observation shack.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It unfolded colossal limbs of dark basalt and stretched toward the clouds, treating the entire eruption like its first morning yawn.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The rescue teams found my abandoned clipboard beside the melted door frame, but where did my heavy boots walk off to?
sentences.speaker: narrator
